native.helperInstallBody: TUN mode needs the privileged helper to create the virtual adapter and take over system traffic. Installing asks for system authorization once; after that, starting and stopping never ask again.
native.helperRepairBody: TUN mode starts the core through the privileged helper. The helper is installed but unusable (usually it needs reinstalling after a version upgrade). Repairing asks for system authorization once.
